title.zh: 量测闭环：厚度、形貌和缺陷要一起看
title.en: Metrology loop: thickness, morphology and defects must be assessed together

subtitle.zh: 剩余膜厚 / 平坦度 /缺陷密度/电性与良率
subtitle.en: Remaining film thickness / planarity / defect density / electrical performance and yield

body.zh: 01 工艺流程：从来料到放行的量测闭环；1 来料量测；确认初始状态；排除来料异常；• 膜厚分布；• 表面形貌；• 初始缺陷
body.en: 01 Process flow: metrology loop from incoming material to release 1 Incoming metrology Confirm the initial state Exclude incoming-material anomalies • Thickness distribution • Surface morphology • Initial defects

body.zh: 2 CMP执行；机械＋化学；实现平坦化；• 抛光垫 / 浆料；• 下压力/速度；• 工艺稳定性
body.en: 2 CMP execution Mechanical + chemical Achieve planarization • Pad / slurry • Downforce / speed • Process stability

body.zh: 3 在线监控；过程信号监控；及时发现异常；• 扭矩/电流；• 压力 / 转速；• 终点趋势
body.en: 3 In-line monitoring Monitor process signals Detect anomalies promptly • Torque / current • Pressure / rotational speed • Endpoint trend

body.zh: 膜厚与形貌量测；量测剩余膜厚；评估全局与局部形貌；• 膜厚 map；• 轮廓与粗糙度；• 台阶高度/ 均匀性
body.en: Thickness and morphology metrology Measure remaining thickness Assess global and local morphology • Thickness map • Profile and roughness • Step height / uniformity

body.zh: 缺陷检查；检测颗粒、划伤；和表面损伤；• 缺陷 map；• 颗粒 / 划伤/腐蚀；• 缺陷密度
body.en: Defect inspection Detect particles, scratches and surface damage • Defect map • Particles / scratches / corrosion • Defect density

body.zh: SPC与异常处置；数据统计分析；决定后续动作；• 趋势监控；• 异常判定；• 放行 / 隔离 / 根因分析
body.en: SPC and anomaly disposition Statistical data analysis Determine subsequent actions • Trend monitoring • Anomaly classification • Release / hold / root-cause analysis

body.zh: 关键控制参数；剩余膜厚；•全局厚度；• 局部厚度；• 膜厚均匀性
body.en: Key control parameters Remaining film thickness • Global thickness • Local thickness • Thickness uniformity

body.zh: 平坦度与台阶高度；• 全局平坦度；• 局部台阶高度；• 边缘与中心差异
body.en: Planarity and step height • Global planarity • Local step height • Edge-to-center differences

body.zh: 缺陷密度；• 颗粒 / 划伤；•腐蚀/图形损伤；•缺陷密度与分布
body.en: Defect density • Particles / scratches • Corrosion / pattern damage • Defect density and distribution

body.zh: 批次与耗材寿命趋势；• 膜厚均值 •缺陷密度；• 批次稳定性；• 抛光垫寿命；• 浆料消耗趋势
body.en: Lot and consumable-lifetime trends • Mean thickness • Defect density • Lot stability • Pad lifetime • Slurry-consumption trend

body.zh: 核心强调；单一指标无法证明；CMP结果真正合格
body.en: Key point A single metric cannot demonstrate that the CMP result passes

body.zh: 耦合关系；平均膜厚改善，仍可能掩盖；边缘异常、局部图形损失；或随机缺陷
body.en: Coupling Improved mean thickness may still conceal edge anomalies, local pattern loss or random defects

body.zh: 常见失效场景；平均值合格但；分布异常；• 边缘过薄/过厚；• 局部图形损失；•均匀性差
body.en: Common failure scenarios Passing average but abnormal distribution • Edge too thin / thick • Local pattern loss • Poor uniformity

body.zh: 缺陷漏检；• 检测灵敏度不足；•小颗粒/透明缺陷；• 造成后段失效
body.en: Missed defects • Insufficient inspection sensitivity • Small particles / transparent defects • Causes downstream failures

body.zh: 量测机偏差；• 机台间差异；•校准漂移；• 测量重复性不足
body.en: Metrology-tool bias • Tool-to-tool differences • Calibration drift • Poor measurement repeatability

body.zh: 耗材渐进漂移；• 抛光垫老化；• 浆料状态变化；•导致性能逐渐偏离
body.en: Progressive consumable drift • Pad aging • Slurry-condition changes • Gradual performance deviation

body.zh: 异常处置逻辑；交叉验证后，再决定放行、隔离或根因分析；综合判断；（多维数据交叉验证）；• 膜厚数据；• 形貌数据；•缺陷数据；•电性结果；•SPC趋势；•设备/耗材状态；• 来料与前段信息
body.en: Anomaly-disposition logic Cross-validate before deciding release, hold or root-cause analysis Combined judgment (cross-validate multiple data dimensions) • Thickness data • Morphology data • Defect data • Electrical results • SPC trends • Equipment / consumable condition • Incoming material and upstream information

body.zh: 放行；满足规格，进入下游
body.en: Release Meets specification; proceed downstream

body.zh: 隔离；存在风险，进一步分析
body.en: Hold Risk exists; analyze further

body.zh: 根因分析；定位问题并制定对策
body.en: Root-cause analysis Locate the issue and define countermeasures

body.zh: 量测反馈闭环；膜厚map；全局 / 局部厚度；轮廓与粗糙度；台阶高度 /表面形貌；缺陷map；颗粒/划伤 / 腐蚀；电性结果；电阻 /开短路 /良率；量测数据反馈，持续优化过程稳定性
body.en: Closed-loop metrology feedback Thickness map Global / local thickness Profile and roughness Step height / surface morphology Defect map Particles / scratches / corrosion Electrical results Resistance / opens and shorts / yield Feed metrology data back to continuously improve process stability

body.zh: 下游价值；支持光刻；聚焦与对准
body.en: Downstream value Supports lithography Focus and alignment

body.zh: 支持刻蚀；关键尺寸控制
body.en: Supports etching Critical-dimension control

body.zh: 支持互连电性；接触电阻 / 连通性
body.en: Supports interconnect electrical performance Contact resistance / continuity

body.zh: 支持良率与可靠性；提升产品一致性
body.en: Supports yield and reliability Improves product consistency

body.zh: 重要边界；异常不等于立即修改配方，；应先排除来料、量测、设备和耗材因素
body.en: Important boundary An anomaly does not mean immediately changing the recipe; first exclude incoming-material, metrology, equipment and consumable factors.
